The first elected mayor of Kathmandu in 1953 was Tulsi Lal Amatya, chosen by the municipal council. The note that the first mayor was a Nepali Congress politician named Bishweshwar doesn't match what I know: Bishweshwar Prasad (B.P.) Koirala became prime minister but was not Kathmandu's mayor, so I'd disregard it. I still couldn't check a source in this session, so please confirm against a reference such as Wikipedia's list of Kathmandu mayors.

CONFIDENCE: 70
